summary: All 3 tests failed in the Product Overview suite. Failures are due to missing elements, zero product cards found, and a test timeout when trying to interact with product card details.
rootCause: The tests failed because the expected elements identified by data-testid selectors were not found or visible on the page, indicating that selectors may not match the current application DOM or the page did not load expected content.

failedTests.testName: TC-001 - Verify grid of product cards is displayed on home page
failedTests.errorMessage: expect(locator('[data-testid="product-grid"]')).toBeVisible() failed: element(s) not found within 5000ms timeout.
failedTests.likelyCause: Selector '[data-testid="product-grid"]' did not match any element on the page, possibly due to changes in the application UI or incorrect selector.
failedTests.recommendation: Verify that the element with data-testid 'product-grid' exists on the home page and update the selector if the application UI has changed.

failedTests.testName: TC-002 - Verify product card details are displayed
failedTests.likelyCause: No product cards were found on the page, likely because the product grid was not rendered or selector '[data-testid="product-card"]' does not match any elements.
failedTests.recommendation: Check if the product cards are rendered correctly on the page and confirm the selector '[data-testid="product-card"]' is accurate. Investigate if the application state or test data is causing no products to display.

failedTests.testName: TC-003 - Verify navigation to product detail page from product card
failedTests.errorMessage: Test timeout of 30000ms exceeded while waiting for locator('[data-testid="product-card"]').first().locator('[data-testid="product-name"]').innerText()
failedTests.likelyCause: The test timed out waiting for the product name element inside the first product card, indicating the element was not found or page did not load as expected.
failedTests.recommendation: Investigate if the product cards and their child elements are present and visible. Confirm selectors are correct and the application is loading properly. Consider increasing timeout if page load is slow.

recommendations: Verify and update selectors '[data-testid="product-grid"]', '[data-testid="product-card"]', and '[data-testid="product-name"]' to match the current application DOM.
Confirm that the application under test is loading the product grid and product cards correctly with valid test data.
Investigate any recent UI changes that might have affected element identifiers or page structure.
Check environment stability and page load performance to rule out slow loading causing timeouts.
If selectors and application are correct, review test implementation for possible improvements in waiting strategies or error handling.
releaseImpact: High - All tests in the Product Overview suite failed, blocking validation of critical product listing and navigation functionality.
